source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 2 同主题完形(我的智能闹钟/学校的机器人助手/语音控制的厨房/未来的医生/雨夜的智能伞/给未来自己的信)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: My Smart Alarm Clock
passages.text: Last week my parents bought a smart alarm clock, and it has completely changed my morning (1)____. Instead of ringing loudly, it slowly turns up the light, so I wake up feeling (2)____ rather than shocked. While I am still in bed, it quietly tells me the weather (3)____ for the day. If the roads are busy, it will (4)____ me to leave home a little earlier. The clock has learned my (5)____, so it knows that I like soft music in the morning. It is also connected to the kitchen, and it can (6)____ on the coffee machine before I get up. At first I thought such a clock was just a silly (7)____, but now I find it really (8)____. It saves me time and helps me feel (9)____ during the day. Thanks to this little machine, I am never (10)____ for school any more.

weather forecast 天气预报。

learned my preferences 了解我的偏好。

a silly fantasy 愚蠢的幻想。

passages.title: The Robot Helper at School
passages.text: This year our school got its first robot (1)____, and the students love it. The robot can move around the library and help us (2)____ the books we need. If you ask a question, it will give you a quick and (3)____ answer in a friendly voice. It uses small (4)____ to know where people are, so it never bumps into anyone. Some teachers worried that the robot would (5)____ their jobs, but that did not happen. Instead, it does the boring (6)____ work, such as putting books back, so the teachers have more time to (7)____ us. At first a few students wanted to (8)____ the idea, but soon they changed their minds. Now the robot is the most popular (9)____ at school. In the future, we will probably be (10)____ together with such machines every day.

help us find the books 帮我们找书。
a relevant answer 切题的回答。
small sensors 小型传感器。
take their jobs 抢走他们的工作。
the boring routine work 无聊的日常工作。
more time to help us 更多时间帮我们。
resist the idea 抵制这个想法。
the most popular helper 最受欢迎的助手。

passages.title: A Kitchen That Listens
passages.text: My uncle's new kitchen can understand (1)____ commands, which still amazes me. When he wants the lights on, he just (2)____ aloud what he wants, and the kitchen will (3)____. He can ask it to warm the oven or play music while he cooks. The kitchen uses clever (4)____ to know when the food is ready, so nothing ever gets burned. If a water pipe starts to (5)____, the system will (6)____ the problem at once and send a (7)____ to his phone. My uncle says this technology is no longer a (8)____; it is part of everyday life. He believes that in the near future, most homes will be (9)____ such smart systems. For now, I just enjoy watching the kitchen do its work all by (10)____.

says aloud what he wants 把想做的事说出来。
the kitchen will obey 厨房会照做。
clever sensors 灵敏的传感器。

detect the problem 察觉问题。
send a warning 发出警告。
no longer a fantasy 不再是幻想。
be using such smart systems 使用这样的智能系统。

passages.title: The Doctor of the Future
passages.text: In the future, going to see a doctor may be very (1)____ from today. You might not even leave your home. Instead, a small machine on your wrist will keep (2)____ track of your health all day long. If it (3)____ that something is wrong, it will (4)____ you a message at once. A doctor far away can then look at your information through a (5)____ link and decide what to do. For a serious or (6)____ illness, tiny robots might even be sent into your body to carry (7)____ to exactly the right place. Such treatment could (8)____ save many lives. Of course, this kind of care is still being (9)____, and we must make sure it is safe. (10)____, many doctors believe it will soon become a normal part of medicine.

if it detects something wrong 如果它察觉异常。
send you a message 给你发消息。

carry medicine 携带药物。

still being tested 仍在测试中。
Nevertheless 尽管如此(句首副词)。

passages.title: The Smart Umbrella
passages.text: One rainy evening, my smart umbrella saved my day. Before I left the office, it checked the weather (1)____ and told me a storm was coming. As I walked outside, small (2)____ in the handle felt the wind and held the umbrella (3)____ against it, so it never turned inside out. When the rain grew heavy, a soft light came on the (4)____ I needed it, helping me see the dark path. The umbrella was also connected to my phone, so it could (5)____ me if I was about to leave it behind on the bus. My friends thought a clever umbrella was just a (6)____ at first, but they soon wanted one too. It is amazing how a (7)____ object can become so useful. In the near future, we will probably be (8)____ many such smart things every day. They make life safer, more (9)____, and a little more fun. For me, the rainy walk home was no longer a (10)____ at all.

small sensors 小型传感器。

the instant I needed it 我一需要它就……。
warn me 提醒我。
just a fantasy 不过是幻想。

passages.title: A Letter to My Future Self
passages.text: Dear future me, I am writing this letter to (1)____ what your life might be like. By the time you read it, you will probably be (2)____ in a smart home that cooks and cleans by itself. I (3)____ that cars will drive themselves, so you will never need a (4)____ licence. Maybe you will have a job that does not even (5)____ today, working side by side with clever machines. I hope you have not learned to (6)____ change, but have chosen to welcome it instead. Remember that more technology does not always bring more (7)____; what matters is how wisely you use it. Keep a strong (8)____ on family and friends, just as we do now. I am a little (9)____ about the future, but mostly I feel excited. (10)____, I believe the years ahead will be full of fresh chances. Good luck — I am sure you will do well!
